## About
Cleoops.com is an independent AI resource for professionals, creators, and business owners.
We publish practical guides, tool reviews, how-to tutorials, and industry strategy analysis.
All content is original, tested, and practitioner-focused — not aggregated or AI-generated without human review.

## Owner
Andrew Goode — SVP Strategy, OpenX. Independent AI commentator and practitioner.
Contact: hello@cleoops.com

- AI strategy for business and industry
- Programmatic advertising and AI
- AI for content creators, teachers, freelancers, job seekers
